selection.rule: use the source high_statistics_summary and exclude only P154 10M variance pilots

confidence.calibration: two-sided Gaussian Bonferroni; K=3.25 is conservatively above the nominal z_(1-0.01/16)
confidence.covariance: intrinsic-center first-order A_top/E_top covariance from each aligned production archive
confidence.arithmetic: every saved feasibility margin is evaluated exactly as a rational number

free_ratio_model.relation: E_top=r*A_top for one common real r
